`createHevyClient(...)` returns an object whose 22 public methods (`getWorkouts`, `getWorkout`, `createWorkout`, `updateWorkout`, `getWorkoutCount`, `getWorkoutEvents`, `getRoutines`, `getRoutineById`, `createRoutine`, `updateRoutine`, `getExerciseTemplates`, `getExerciseTemplate`, `getEx ... Fail if any public method returns an Effect (`_op` / `pipe` / not a thenable), if `"requestEffect" in client` is true, if `client.requestEffect` is defined, if any method is typed as `Effect.Effect<...>`, or if `const _: Promise<unknown> = client.<method>(...)` fails for any public method.
